[EN] I'm the official delegate for the affairs between Bastion and Archive Stronghold, so I'm quite busy nowadays.
[ES] Soy el delegado oficial para los asuntos entre Bastion y Archive Stronghold, así que estoy bastante ocupado hoy en día.

[EN] You have broken both of Seren's Seals. All that remains now is to go to Balder's Temple."For the federation."
[ES] Has roto ambos sellos de Seren. Todo lo que queda ahora es ir a Balder's Temple."For the federation."

[EN] , thank you for showing me that the prophecy was not false."Glad to do it."
[ES] , gracias por demostrarme que la profecía no era falsa."Glad to do it."
